title: In the AFTER screenshot (opponent's Turn 6 Beginning Phase, Loose Cannon trigger on the chain, banner 'Goldfish has Priority — waiting...'), the player's action panel still offers 'Exhaust Rune (4 available)' and 'Recycle Rune (4 available)' as available actions.
expected: Screenshot 38.png verified: Turn 6 BEGINNING, chain shows Loose Cannon (Goldfish ability), banner 'Goldfish has Priority — waiting...', and player's Rune Actions panel lists 'Exhaust Rune (4 available)' / 'Recycle Rune (4 available)'. Source cause: engine move `exhaustRune.condition`/`enumerator` (resources.ts:71-117) and `recycleRune.condition`/`enumerator` (resources.ts:141-195) only check pendingChoice, status==='playing', zone===runePool, ownership, and exhausted flag — no check of turn/priority/chain state. Line 79 comment explicitly states 'Players can exhaust runes at any time' (same at line 149). The UI (apps/riftbound-app/public/js/gameplay/render/actions.js:344-415) renders whatever the engine enumerates with no priority gating. Rules: 164.2.a/b make rune abilities [Reaction] Add abilities; 312.1.a/b say only the player with Priority may take discretionary actions/activate abilities; 429.3 carves out only the pay-costs window. Player-1 has neither here, so offering these moves is a rules deviation rooted in the engine condition.
